question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4'** i.e.** 'Same'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **sentence is describing **events that are happening on a particular morning. After explaining what the students are doing, the sentence switches to describe what staff members are doing at a homeless shelter.
 
• The word **"same"** is **used to **indicate that the events at the homeless shelter were happening on the same morning that the students were working on the portable air purifiers.
 
• The use of **"same"** establishes a connection between the two events and helps the reader understand that they are happening concurrently.
 
• The** other options** such as "copy," "cruel," and "resembling"** do not fit **the context of the sentence as they don't establish this connection.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *'One afternoon, a dozen Arizona State University students gathered to spend the morning cutting cardboard, taping fans and assembling filters in an effort to build 125 portable air purifiers for local schools. That **same **morning, staff members at a homeless shelter in Los Angeles were setting (4)_______ 20 homemade purifiers of their own, while in Brookline, Massachusetts, another DIY air purifier was whirring quietly in the back of a day care (5)______ as children played.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Copy** (प्रतिलिपि) - Refers to a duplicate or imitation of something; not suitable in this context.
 
• **Cruel **(क्रूर) - Means lacking human feelings or compassion; not relevant here.
 
• **Resembling** (समान) - Refers to being similar in appearance; doesn’t fit the context.
